archetypes.name: bash-contracts
archetypes.rationale: The diff changes bash control flow, sourcing behavior, command substitutions, and set -e boundaries.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the shell changes for bash semantics, especially set -e/set +e regions, command substitutions, function export/source behavior, traps, and cleanup paths. Check whether helper sourcing can unexpectedly alter caller state or cause early exits. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: state-machine
archetypes.rationale: The change depends on precise design-step sentinel transitions across pause/save/load and Gate B bypass paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether the Step 3, Step 3.5, Step 3.6, and Step 3b sentinel transitions remain coherent across the SKILL prose, helper tests, pause-save, and pause-load expectations. Look for bypass cases that could pass from pre-seeded state rather than proving the intended empty-state transition. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: kv-warnings
archetypes.rationale: The postplan path changes stderr capture and WARN KV propagation under quiet mode.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review classification warning capture and WARN emission for single-line KV safety, result-env consistency, stderr temp-file handling, and fallback behavior when classification fails. Check whether warnings are preserved without clobbering existing warning arrays or producing malformed contract output. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: grep-scope
archetypes.rationale: The structure harness adds scoped extraction and pattern-based anti-shape assertions that may be brittle.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine the new grep, sed, and awk region-scoping assertions for marker drift, false positives, false negatives, and assumptions about branch ordering. Pay special attention to the Step 3.6 thin-fence region and the named Gate-B-bypass branch extraction. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
